findings.reason: The evidence shows the alarm and impact, but does not prove the alarm was the cause of the degradation.
T3 and T1 explicitly show latency increases and volume drops starting at 19:30 on S-SFX-009.
ALM-000604 and T4 confirm the alarm type, node, and exact start/end times.
T2 confirms the shared path and T7 shows the specific KPI deviations for both sibling sites.
T5 and T6 explicitly report no maintenance or changes for the cited nodes and time window.
The cited observations of simultaneous degradation on all connected sites make the causal link a reasonable inference.
